STEP 1 Description: Protocols that seek to open a gauge to be voted on have to request a whitelisting by presenting a proposal.

Gauges Description: Gauges are used to measure voting power. veTHE holders can allocate their voting power to different liquidity pools through these gauges. This voting determines how the protocol’s emissions or rewards are distributed among the pools. The more voting power a pool has via the gauge, the larger the share of THE rewards it receives.
Create New Gauge: Create a new gauge which can be used for staking and voting.

Voting Incentive Description: To encourage votes towards specific pools, protocols or projects may deposit additional rewards or incentives into those pools' gauges. These incentives are designed to attract more voting power by offering token holders higher potential returns for their votes. Essentially, the more voting power a gauge receives, the more THE emissions are allocated to the liquidity pool.
